description: Welcome to one of the best weather apps on the Play Store, recognized as one of the best for its accuracy, widget flexibility, and ease-of-use. Our intuitively designed interface provides you with informative, useful, and precise weather updates for your local area and around the globe, all accompanied by stunningly detailed animations. Main App Features: • Accurate and comprehensive weather forecasts for the next 10 days • Hour-by-hour weather updates to help you plan your activities with precision • Fast, beautiful, and simple-to-use interface • Detailed forecasts for rain, snow, wind, storms and many other useful information - stay prepared for all weather conditions • Daily updates on humidity, dew, UV index, and air pressure • Data on highest and lowest historical weather values • Dynamic animations of satellite and weather radar maps • Weather also available in the notification area with the temperature display in your status bar • Optimized for both phones and tablets, and fully compatible with your favorite Wear OS smartwatch Customizable Home Screen Widgets: • Highly configurable widgets with extensive customization options available to adjust the look, ensuring seamless integration with your home screen • Choose the size, layout, and appearance of your widget, select what weather information to display, and even adjust text size and colors • Get quick weather snapshots without even opening the app, right from your home screen • Convenience at its best, with visually pleasing designs to suit your style and preference Live Wallpaper Feature: • Experience our Live Wallpaper feature, displaying mesmerizing weather animations right on your device screen (subject to device compatibility) • Enjoy real-time weather updates in the most visually engaging way Severe Weather Alerts: • Stay safe and informed with critical information about severe weather warnings • Alerts issued by official national weather services from around the globe, ensuring comprehensive coverage Alerts availability: https://exovoid.ch/alerts Air Quality and Pollen Information: • Detailed air quality information sourced from official stations to keep you healthy • Track key pollutants including ground-level ozone, particle pollution (PM2.5 and PM10), carbon monoxide, sulfur dioxide, and nitrogen dioxide Air quality Information availability: https://exovoid.ch/aqi Smartwatch App Features List: • Included: "Tile" and "Complications" • Check the weather for your current location or any city in the world (requires main app to sync cities) • Hourly and daily weather forecasts • Info available hour by hour: Temperature, Probability of rain, Wind speed, Cloud cover, Humidity, Pressure, UV index • Touch the screen to view the information available hour by hour • Weather Alerts • Settings screen for customization Try the best weather app now – experience simplicity, usefulness, and informative power like never before, all for free! -- Location data during the use of App Unlike many other apps on the market, we never send information like your location to a server, everything is processed on your device. We've designed our weather apps so that the user's precise location remains on the phone and is converted into the nearest weather station ID. What's more, weather requests linked to a station are not stored, so it's impossible to link a user to a weather request. This method ensures anonymity and security for the user. Our weather apps can be used without any form of localisation, you can manually set a location using the search screen. The app will display the forecast for this location each time you will open the app, without trying to localize you. We don't collect any personal information from our users. Privacy Policy & Terms of use: In order to use our apps, please accept our privacy policy and review conditions for third-parties such as advertising partners. https://www.exovoid.ch/privacy-policy
